text:
kai: Quick sync  we're testing Meridian-12B-slim (post-training quant 4-bit) for a low-cost completions tier. Before any customer-facing rollout: need legal read on whether quantized weights / compressed artifacts count as redistributable derivatives and what attribution they want.

anjali: short perf note  4-bit PTQ yields ~2.7x token-cost reduction, p95 latency down 2.3x. Eval: spot regressions on multi-paragraph coherence (-3.4%) and occasional instruction-following drops on very long prompts.

kai: upstream LICENSE has a weird "derivative artifacts" clause. Pasting key lines below.

ops-bot: ```
Meridian Research License v1.0
- Permitted: noncommercial research and evaluation only.
- Redistribution: reproduction or distribution of Model weights or Derivative Artifacts (including quantized binaries or compressed encodings) is prohibited without prior written permission.
- Hosting: operating the Model (or a Derivative) as a paid service requires a commercial license.
- Attribution: Derivative Artifacts must include visible credit and a link to the original license.
```

frank (legal): TL;DR  two likely blockers: (1) hosting-as-paid-service; (2) explicit mention of quantized/encoded artifacts as Derivative Artifacts. Both mean we should not enable a paid hosted endpoint until we get a commercial license or waiver.

anjali: engineering nuance  we never export the quant file off our infra; runtime keeps sharded quant tensors encrypted on disk and in-memory for inference. Does "distribution" vs "hosting" change legality?

frank (legal): practically no. The license calls out hosting separately. Serving inference to paying customers falls squarely under "hosting". Even if you never hand out files, offering outputs to payers is a commercial service.

kai: product question  if redistribution with attribution is allowed, what's minimal attribution? model card + a short "powered by Meridian Research" in Console? Also how do we show it in customer-facing apps (some customers embed model output into their own product UIs).

frank (legal): model card + prominent metadata in Console is usually acceptable. For customer-facing apps, we should require customers to surface attribution if contract requires it; include the attribution requirement in our TOS for that endpoint. We'll confirm exact phrasing with upstream.

product-lead: timeline/scope: we can keep Meridian-slim internal for canary tests and Dedicated/private demos. Sales are asking for a low-latency cheap tier though; how long to get a license?

frank (legal): depends on upstream. First step: outreach asking for (A) confirmation that in-memory serving is considered hosting/derivative, (B) permission to host a quantized runtime for paying customers, (C) the exact attribution language they want, and (D) any commercial terms (fee/revenue share). We'll draft and send today.

anjali: engineering outreach appendix to include: quant method (post-training 4-bit per-channel symmetric), storage (shards encrypted with KMS), we don't publish binary blobs, can implement rate limits and geo-blocking, and auto-fallback to FP16 on regression. We'll also include perf/regression CSV.

ops-bot: policy: tag model onboarding entry "legal:pending" and set "hosted:blocked".

kai: fallback plan if they decline: (1) BYO model in Private (customer uploads their own Meridian binary), (2) for Dedicated-managed we can offer a gated pilot if upstream signs a short-term commercial license, (3) otherwise mark as "hosted:ineligible" in catalog.

frank (legal): action items: 1) kai upload full LICENSE file + upstream commit hash to onboarding folder; 2) anjali attach quant pipeline + perf/regression artifacts; 3) frank + product draft outreach and propose attribution string; 4) product prepare sales messaging for BYO/private fallback. We'll triage in legal+eng sync Fri.

kai: done  uploaded files to /onboard/meridian-12b-slim and flagged the onboarding sheet. pinging @frank when draft ready. :thumbsup:

anjali: added perf CSV: recall-sensitive tasks down -2.9 to -3.6% depending on prompt family; QA tasks -0.8%. Will try a prompt-conditioning fix and re-run.

product-lead: noted - I'll tell sales to use BYO/private messaging for any immediate deals.

frank (legal): one more note for outreach: propose a modest attribution string like "Powered by Meridian-12B-slim (Meridian Research)  License: [URL]" and offer to show the full redistribution notice in our legal docs. Also offer to sign a limited indemnity/pilot terms if needed.

kai: thanks all. keeping thread open for any urgent asks. :wave:
